package com.gauntlethelper.boss;

/** Hunllef tile color modes; values and labels match The Gauntlet's PrayerTileOutline options. */
public enum PrayerTileMode
{
	OFF("Off"),
	ON("On"),
	INVERTED("Inverted");
	private final String name;

	PrayerTileMode(String name) { this.name = name; }
	@Override
	public String toString() { return name; }
}

import java.awt.BasicStroke;

/** The fixed outline widths the overlays share; a stroke whose width is a setting is built where it is drawn. */
final class OverlayStrokes
{
	static final Stroke THIN = new BasicStroke(1);
	static final Stroke MEDIUM = new BasicStroke(2);

	private OverlayStrokes() { }
}

package com.gauntlethelper.plan;

/**
 * The singing bowl and pestle quantities the plan counts in: shards per empty vial, dust per three-dose potion and the
 * ten-shard grind that gives ten dust. Weapon and armor shard costs live in
 * HomeCraftPlan.ATTUNE_SHARDS and ArmorUpgrades.
 */
public final class Recipes
{
	/** Shards the singing bowl takes for one empty crystal vial. */
	public static final int SHARDS_PER_VIAL = 10;
	/** Dust one unfinished potion takes to finish a three-dose potion. */
	public static final int DUST_PER_POTION = 10;
	/** Shards one pestle use grinds, giving as many dust; spare shards short of a batch grind nothing. */
	public static final int GRIND_BATCH = 10;

	private Recipes() {}
}

package com.gauntlethelper.plan;

/** Running-time estimate in game ticks. Equal-time teleports keep the single-use crystal. */
public final class TeleportEstimate
{
	/**
	 * Ticks from using the teleport crystal to standing at home. Measured in recorded runs: the
	 * crystal leaves the inventory exactly 3 ticks before the position changes, in all 32 teleports of 27 runs.
	 */
	public static final int ACTIVATION_TICKS = 3;

	private TeleportEstimate() { }
	public static int getRunningTicks(int tiles) { return (Math.max(0, tiles) + 1) / 2; }
	public static boolean isWorthwhile(int walkingTiles, int activationTicks, int arrivalWalkingTiles)
	{
		return walkingTiles >= 0 && arrivalWalkingTiles >= 0
				&& getRunningTicks(walkingTiles) > Math.max(1, activationTicks) + getRunningTicks(arrivalWalkingTiles);
	}
}

package com.gauntlethelper;

import net.runelite.client.RuneLite;
import net.runelite.client.externalplugins.ExternalPluginManager;

/** Development entry point, not an automated test. */
public class GauntletHelperLauncher
{
	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
	{
		ExternalPluginManager.loadBuiltin(GauntletHelperPlugin.class);
		RuneLite.main(args);
	}
}
